death.attack.water_prison_pressure: %1$s was crushed by water prison pressure
death.attack.fire_resource.player: %1$s was burned out by resource fire whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.steam_burst.player: %1$s was blasted by steam whilst fighting %2$s
technique.xueximod.fire_heat_up.desc: Enter the normal furnace. Mana is kept when the state does not change
technique.xueximod.fire_burn.desc: Enter or upgrade overdrive and keep the current bonus
technique.xueximod.fire_cool.desc: Actively cool the furnace and release one steam burst
technique.xueximod.fire_scorch_field.des: Lay a 4-block terrain-fitting fire patch in front of the caster for 100 ticks. Contacted foes gain fire seeds on first touch and on later pulses
technique.xueximod.fire_liaoyuan.desc: Spreads a radius-10 ground fire that can hit while the frontier expands. Body hits deal 8 base fire every 10 ticks with one furnace bonus; seeded targets also take segments of 4×(1+0.1n+F), each requesting 10 seeds
technique.xueximod.fire_liaoli.desc: Thrust with a held sword. A hit spends the seeds still left and deals one physical strike
technique.xueximod.fire_fentian.desc: Targets in the sphere with seeds gain sky burn. Damage locks at the start for at most 40 ticks, and each segment spends 10 seeds
technique.xueximod.heat_beam.desc: Hold a heat beam that follows the crosshair and damages what it touches. Each accepted hit mounts 1 fire seed
technique.xueximod.fire_orb.desc: Launch a fire orb that damages and ignites on hit. Its path can be rewritten. Each hit target gains 3 fire seeds
technique.xueximod.magic_ignite.desc: Ignite a target or block. An enchanted technique, or the next weapon attack, mounts 2 extra fire seeds when that attack damage is accepted
gui.xueximod.staff.overflow_cast: This chain is longer than the staff slots. The original data is kept and this cast is refused
gui.xueximod.staff.overflow_edit: This chain is longer than the staff slots. The original data is kept. Repair it before editing
gui.xueximod.staff.bad_slots: This staff has an illegal slot count
gui.xueximod.staff.unknown: The chain contains an unregistered technique and cannot be cast
gui.xueximod.staff.sword: Sword techniques cannot be cast from a staff
gui.xueximod.staff.unlearned: This technique is not learned or unlocked
gui.xueximod.batch.unsupported_host: This chain contains a technique that cannot join a batch cast
gui.xueximod.batch.nested: Continuation can only be one layer
gui.xueximod.batch.dual_incomplete: Dual release does not have two hosts
gui.xueximod.batch.motion_conflict: One branch cannot carry two full motions
gui.xueximod.batch.domain_surface: This domain cannot use a surface anchor
gui.xueximod.batch.no_continue_support: This technique cannot join hit continuation
gui.xueximod.batch.surface_rejected: No usable supporting surface in view. Nothing was cast
technique.xueximod.water_phantom.desc: On staff slot 0, place Water Phantom and then Thin Water Cut. A normal cast leaves the figure; sneaking releases it at once. The default charge is 10 deploy mana plus Thin Water Cut 12, taken once, with cooldown 20 plus 20. An unadapted next attack is refused before payment.
technique.xueximod.sword_oblique_slash.d: A directed oblique slash in front of the eyes. It can be cast alone
technique.xueximod.movement_spin.desc: Spin in place. It deals no damage and can be followed by an adapted slash
technique.xueximod.rule_cooperative.desc: The next adapted attack is struck by you and your normal clone. This rule deals no damage
technique.xueximod.clone_body.desc: Place it alone in staff slot 0. Sneaking dismisses your own normal clones
gui.xueximod.cooperative.unadapted_attac: The following attack is not adapted to this action or cooperation
gui.xueximod.cooperative.budget: This cast exceeds the volume or family limit and was not released
gui.xueximod.cooperative.clone_slot: The normal clone must sit alone in staff slot 0. Sneaking dismisses your own normal clones
gui.xueximod.cooperative.clone_mixed: The normal clone cannot be cast together with other techniques
death.attack.counterattack: %1$s was struck down by a counterattack
